description: This file defines a MapStruct mapper interface 'LoanTransactionMapper' that converts 'LoanTransaction' domain objects into 'LoanTransactionData' DTOs, configuring specific field mappings and ignoring certain fields. It is part of the Apache Fineract project, specifically related to loan account transactions.

classes.name: LoanTransactionMapper
classes.description: MapStruct mapper interface to convert LoanTransaction domain objects into LoanTransactionData DTOs with custom mappings.

methods.name: mapLoanTransaction
methods.description: Maps a LoanTransaction domain object to LoanTransactionData DTO, applying specific field ignore and transformation rules.
